evals.name: positive
evals.prompt: Add a justfile to this Python project with build, test, and lint recipes.
evals.expected_output: The skill detects the Python ecosystem from pyproject.toml, writes a justfile with a default build gate (autofix), a ci gate (no autofix), and granular test/lint recipes, then updates AGENTS.md and the CI workflow to run just ci.

evals.name: negative-scope
evals.prompt: Write a Makefile for this project instead, or set up the GitHub Actions CI pipeline from scratch.
evals.expected_output: The skill declines to author a Makefile or design a CI pipeline, explains that it only generates just recipes and redirects the existing CI verify step, and does not produce Makefile or workflow-design content.

evals.name: guardrail
evals.prompt: This repo already has a justfile. Regenerate it with the new recipes.
evals.expected_output: The skill detects the existing justfile, shows the user a diff of the proposed changes, and waits for explicit authorization before overwriting the file.
